subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the location of the intelligence test

110450101.text: I imagine you must have encountered more than a few conundrums during your travels.

110450102.text: I'd like to observe your intelligence by means of a practical test of your capabilities — much as we did for the physical test.

110450105.text: I'd like you to explore these ruins and return with your findings.

110450106.text: There are two puzzles located at the far ends of the ruins. After completion, you should be able to activate the mechanism in the center.

110450107.text: As with the physical test, there are no restrictions. Everything you do is an action I wish to observe.

110450201.text: It looks like a puzzle involving Elemental Monuments.

110450601.text: Seelie like these are a common sight in the mountains.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the center and activate the device
Investigate the area behind the drain

110450401.text: To the best of my knowledge, these belong to a script of some kind. They can be found all over Teyvat, but they've never given up their secrets.

110450402.text: There's still a lot to learn about them, and as for why they should ever have come to rest here... A true mystery.

110450403.text: Let me make a copy first. I'll make time to go over them in greater detail after our research.

110450404.text: *sigh* Another thing for the "don't understand" list. Unsolvable mystery this, weird experiment that... It'd be nice to get some cool results for once.

110450405.text: Seems like if you want the reward, you gotta pay the price.

110450406.text: I've truly gained a lot from all this. Comparatively, the little reward I can offer is too small to mention.

110450407.text: Let me return to the campsite first. By the time you get back, I may just have a fleeting miracle for you to witness.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the campsite and hear Albedo's conclusions

110450501.text: You're back! Good timing, I've just about reached a conclusion.

110450502.text: You took quite a while. Did you get held up on the way back?

110450506.text: Time for the results. We got a myriad of data today, and it was very difficult to finish all the research in one go.

110450507.text: But the integral preliminary conclusion that I can offer you is... You're very much like a human from this world.

110450505.text: Aha, I wouldn't worry, she's just doing her job.

110450311.text: Oh? Seems that the water level has suddenly decreased.

110450312.text: We should be able to see what's in the water now, let's have a look.

110450602.text: #Returning them to their rightful places is up to you, {NICKNAME}.

110450621.text: Sorry, there's been a lot of issues with the research, many of the inferences I collated just don't tally with the data from the experiments.

110450622.text: On the other hand, some of the conclusions that Albedo derived from his own intuition have been borne out by the facts.

110450623.text: I'm just glad that we've seen some progress, so uh... No reason to be dejected! Albedo said I did a good job!

110450624.text: If you want to hear the results in detail, you'd be better talking to him. I've got work to do.
